prompt: In a crisp anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where natural light floods through large windows. On the far left, a man in a red scarf stands holding a boarding pass, his posture rigid with anticipation. Next to him sits a brown dog on a blue leash, panting slightly with its tongue out. The man looks at the dog, creating a quiet moment of connection amidst the chaos. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow dress points toward a digital departure board, her arm extended gracefully. Beside her, a child in a striped shirt looks at the same board, eyes wide with wonder. A silver suitcase rests next to the child, its handle upright and gleaming under the lights. Behind them, an elderly woman in a floral hat sits on a metal bench, her hands folded neatly in her lap. A young man in a leather jacket leans against a pillar near her, checking his wristwatch with a frown. To the right, a barista in a green apron hands a coffee cup to a businessman in a grey suit, who accepts it with a nod. The businessman holds a black briefcase tightly in his other hand. Near the window on the right, a girl in a pink hoodie listens to music through large headphones, swaying gently to an unheard rhythm. A stray cat with orange fur jumps onto an empty seat next to her, curling up instantly. Above them, a ceiling fan spins slowly, its blades blurred in motion. A potted plant with broad green leaves stands in the corner, adding a touch of nature to the sterile environment. There is no snow visible outside the windows, nor is there any military personnel present in the terminal. The composition captures the transient nature of travel through these distinct figures and their subtle connections.
